known_outcome: The Tribunal ordered the Notice of Cancellation revoked (p.1; para 68). Reasoning: the building falls under the farm-building exemption and does not require a permit (paras 55-59, 67).
review_focus: Whether the farm-building exemption quoted at para 26 applies to a greenhouse with planting boxes as described, versus a building for vehicle storage.
Whether a Safety Codes Officer has authority to issue or cancel a permit for a building claimed to be exempt (Appellant's argument, para 9).
Whether the stated use, the plans and the complaint evidence are consistent, and what verification the file shows.
Setback and floor-plan completeness raised in the denied application (para 34) and whether the accepted application addressed them (para 35 does not say).
Separation of land-use questions (primary-dwelling and bylaw points raised in the decision) from building-code questions.
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
